criteria: PASS  [behaviour] rule seats giving goals, whose commanders draft and execute plans, move divisions, change control through battles and occupation (a battle-day or an occupation, and a control change), and derive fronts, pockets and supply
PASS  [hash] the same state hash on every run, with State frozen or not (Linux against Windows is the CI determinism job, over the summaries this writes)
PASS  [resume] a mid-run save, loaded, resumes to the continuous run’s final hash, and the log replays to every hash
PASS  [liveness] every Phase 0 mechanic is inside its band in the reference runs, or quiet for a stated reason
PASS  [section-ten] the tests named in FOUNDATION section 10 are present and none is skipped (that they pass is the suite’s)
FAIL  [budget] the day's cost stays inside the 40 ms tick budget (median), and its slowest days inside 4 times it (p95), measured with the planner, people and situations running (1A)

PASS  [checkpoints] the history run reaches its last checkpoint with each side at war by its own decision (no --at-war), and every checkpoint falls inside its sourced band: states seceded, the sides of the governments that could change, Washington held, men under arms, planned operations fought
PASS  [operation] at least one operation drafted by the kernel planner, chosen by its commander’s seat, approved, executed and fought with the battle model, with a breakdown
FAIL  [pushback] pushback fires inside its bands: lower bounds from the record’s sourced cases (S01–S21), upper bounds the lead’s
PASS  [unknown-strength] no block fights with unknown strength: every battle record, in every run, lists none unknown
PASS  [stand-ins] the eight stand-ins Phase 0 labelled are gone, and any stand-in left in the code is labelled and owned by a 1B lane

FAIL  [lever-sweep] the lever sweep (D6): no watched option, nor an atrocity-class decision’s inaction, is the victory-only bot’s best choice in more than a quarter of the seeds; no floor goes unpaid; recruitment is active
